description: FREE lite buying-pressure + holder-health report for one Solana memecoin. Top-line only: net inflow needed for 2x, 5x and 10x moves, percent of sampled wallets in profit, total unrealized PnL headline, weighted average cost, MVRV and sample coverage. The full ladder (1.5x-100x), gross-of-fee figures, reserves, UPNL vs liquidity and per-holder detail are capped. Use it to triage whether a token deserves the full token_pressure report.

mint.description: Solana token mint address (base58, 32-44 chars), e.g. Ce2gx9KGXJ6C9Mp5b5x1sn9Mg87JwEbrQby4Zqo3pump. EVM 0x addresses are rejected — this is a Solana tool.

name: token_pressure_lite
